newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-HINGIS ADVANCES TO PARIS OPEN SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS ADVANCES TO PARIS OPEN SEMIFINAL.

text.p: Top seed Martina Hingis of Switzerland advanced to the semifinals of the Paris Open women's tournament by crushing Nathalie Tauziat of France in straight sets on Friday.
World number two Hingis, who has yet to lose a match this year, recorded an impressive 6-3 6-2 win to set up a semifinal clash with Iva Majoli of Croatia.
Majoli was made to work hard by unseeded Yayuk Basuki of Indonesia before winning 7-6 3-6 6-3.

Eighth seed Mary Pierce of France, who lost to Hingis in the Australian Open final last month and was hoping for a rematch here on Sunday, was demolished 6-1 6-2 by second seed Jana Novotna of the Czech Republic.
Novotna will now meet third seed Anke Huber of Germany, who beat Irina Spirlea of Romania 6-4 6-2.
